verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a first-party AI plugin and a built-in LLM chat window. It can link to sessions, run commands on your behalf, and explain output. A hands-on user reports turning a plain-English request into a working awk command much faster than searching documentation. The feature is optional, needs its own plugin install and a user-supplied API key, and is only ever shown working on shell commands, not on iTerm2 itself. Missing for 10: evidence of controlling iTerm2's own features (panes, profiles, settings) by natural language, in-depth first-party documentation of the chat and command-execution workflow, and use without a separately installed plugin and bring-your-own API key.
